zh.title: 工单要求 500 元，回执却写 790 元：AI 员工该再订一笔吗？
zh.summary: 发现回执金额不符，AI 仍可能重复下单。两组交接实验观察数字员工如何依据改价记录和原单状态，选择沿用、补订或继续查。

en.title: Before a Lesson Enters the Skill Library, Bind It to the Program That Was Tested
en.summary: Program measurements, proposal judgments and admitted edits need separate acceptance. Two studies and eight internal function fixtures show what exact-program binding checks, while leaving per-edit semantic correspondence unverified.
